items.title: Fervo Energy Lost 36% in a Month on a Short Report. Morgan Stanley Sees 150% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFervo Energy stock lost 36% in the past month after Morpheus Research published a short report alleging problems at its geothermal plants. Fervo calls the report a selective reading of early pilot data, and its first Cape Station GeoBlock is producing 33 MW under its power contract.
